p: Theme configuration for the hierarchical menu
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 45, 45, 48): Gets or sets the background color of the menu
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 63, 63, 70): Gets or sets the border color of the menu
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 241, 241, 241): Gets or sets the text color for menu items
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 128, 128, 128): Gets or sets the text color for disabled menu items
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 62, 62, 64): Gets or sets the background color when hovering over menu items
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 122, 204): Gets or sets the background color for active/selected menu items
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 63, 63, 70): Gets or sets the color of separator lines in the menu
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 241, 241, 241): Gets or sets the color of menu item icons
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(255, 128, 128, 128): Gets or sets the color of keyboard shortcut text
(float) { get; set } = 1f: Gets or sets the width of the menu border in pixels
(float) { get; set } = 2f: Gets or sets the offset of the menu shadow in pixels
(Color) { get; set } = Color.FromArgb(100, 0, 0, 0): Gets or sets the color of the menu shadow
